text:
maria: Heads up — after the rbac-refactor deploy last night some users can log in but get assigned the 'viewer' role instead of 'admin'. Seeing spikes in support tickets.

alex: Confirmed. I pulled a SAML assertion from the logs and the attribute we use for role mapping (redwood_roles) is coming back empty for a subset of users who previously had multiple roles.

jamie: Any recent changes to Okta mappings or transforms? I didn't touch the app yesterday.

alex: We rolled a small change to the Okta SAML AttributeStatement transform to normalize spacing and remove duplicates. The transform uses a regex replace that accidentally removes commas when there are spaces around them. Example from the mapping: 
```
var roles = user.roles.replace(/\s*,\s*/g, ''); // oops 
return roles;
```
This turns "admin, analytics" into "adminanalytics" which doesn't match our RBAC rules, so JIT falls back to viewer.

maria: Yikes. That explains it. Any affected sessions currently live?

okta-bot: JIT_PROV Event: user_id=U-1023, email=alice@example.com, action=provision, assigned_groups=[viewer], source=okta-app/redwood-prod, ts=1742003800

sre-oncall: We have two customers reporting degraded permissions for internal tools. Creating an incident ticket INC-2025-154 and pausing the Okta transform rollout.

alex: Quick mitigation: revert the replace to preserve commas/and trim with split/join: 
```
var roles = user.roles.split(',').map(function(r){return r.trim();}).join(',');
return roles;
```
That should restore the original comma-separated list.

jamie: I'll patch the Okta mapping now and push. Will also add a unit test in our onboarding script to validate comma-separated role values in SAML assertions.

eva: Can we triage scope? Which customers impacted? We should check audit logs for any privilege drops.

alex: Running a quick query against the SAML assertion logs for the last 6 hours for attribute redwood_roles != null but not matching expected pattern. Will post results in ~10m.

oliver: Heads-up for product: this affects canary group and 5 orgs in prod. Reverted mapping should go live in next 5–10 mins.

okta-bot: Config change applied to app redwood-prod by jamie at ts=1742004012.

jamie: Patch deployed. I validated with two test accounts — roles now parse correctly and JIT assigns admin when appropriate.

alex: Audit query result: 42 users had malformed role attributes; 32 were auto-provisioned as viewer. I'll prepare a remediation script to re-run JIT for affected users (force-sync) after we confirm no other side effects.

maria: Thanks. Next steps: (1) run remediation script after ops approval, (2) add integration test to CI for Okta mapping edge cases, (3) document the transform in eng-security runbook.

sre-oncall: Noted and marking incident resolved once remediation completes.

eva: Notifying the few customers affected with an explanation and the rollback.

maria: Great work. Postmortem + action items to eng-security/incidents repo once we finish. :thumbsup:
